license_required.quote: No person shall act as property bondsman, limited surety agent or solicitor, or perform any functions or duties or exercise any of the powers prescribed for bail bondsmen or solicitors in Chapter 59A, Article 51 NMSA 1978 unless such person is qualified and licensed as provided in that article.

issuing_authority.quote: An individual desiring to be licensed as bail bondsman or solicitor under the Bail Bondsmen Licensing Law shall file with the superintendent a written application

name.quote: An individual desiring to be licensed as bail bondsman or solicitor under the Bail Bondsmen Licensing Law shall file with the superintendent a written application

type.quote: The superintendent shall act upon application for license under this article within a reasonable period after the application has been filed with him.

interval_years.quote: subject to continuation annually by payment in advance of the continuation fee specified therefor in Section 101 [59A-6-1 NMSA 1978] (fee schedule) of the Insurance Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it existed and been known at the time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the superintendent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement, misrepresentation or fraud in obtaining the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a material misstatement, misrepresentation or fraud in obtaining the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of the laws of this state relating to bail or the bail bond business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any violation of the laws of this state relating to bail or the bail bond business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriation, conversion or unlawful withholding of money belonging to insurers or others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: misappropriation, conversion or unlawful withholding of money belonging to insurers or others and received in the conduct of business under the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or dishonest practices in the conduct of business under the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulent or dishonest practices in the conduct of business under the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with or willful violation of the Bail Bondsmen Licensing Law or any order, rule or regulation of the superintendent or any court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with, or willful violation of, any provision of the Bail Bondsmen Licensing Law or proper order, rule or regulation of the superintendent or any court of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any activity prohibited in Section 59A-51-13 NMSA 1978
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any activity prohibited in Section 59A-51-13 NMSA 1978

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to pay over to any insurer money belonging to the insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure or refusal, upon demand, to pay over to any insurer that the licensee represented, any money coming into the licensee's hands belonging to the insurer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to preserve without use and retain separately or to return collateral taken as security on any bond
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to preserve without use and retain separately or to return collateral taken as security on any bond to the principal, indemnitor or depositor of collateral when the principal, indemnitor or depositor is entitled to such collateral

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing a person whose bail bond business license has been revoked, suspended or denied
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for knowingly having in the bail bondsman's employ a person whose bail bond business license has been revoked, suspended or denied in this or any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure, neglect or refusal to supervise a solicitor's activities on the bail bondsman's behalf
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure, neglect or refusal to supervise a solicitor's activities on the bail bondsman's behalf

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated incompetency, untrustworthiness, or conduct rendering the licensee unfit or detrimental to the public interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee in the conduct of affairs under the license has demonstrated incompetency, untrustworthiness, conduct or practices rendering the licensee unfit to engage in the bail bond business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of rebating or offering to rebate commissions or premiums
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee is guilty of rebating, or offering to rebate the licensee's commissions in the case of limited surety agents or premiums in the case of property bondsmen

bonding_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license to act as property bondsman, the applicant therefor shall deposit with the superintendent a surety bond in favor of the superintendent, or in lieu thereof a certificate of deposit, securities or a letter of credit issued by an institution, acceptable to the superintendent, and which letter is irrevocable for the term of the license, in a total aggregate amount of not less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000)

definition_quote.value: bail bondsman means a limited surety agent or a property bondsman
definition_quote.quote: "bail bondsman" means a limited surety agent or a property bondsman as hereafter defined

value: execute or countersign bail bonds in connection with judicial proceedings (limited surety agent)
pledge United States currency, postal money orders, cashier's checks or other property as security or surety for a bail bond (property bondsman)
assist in presenting defendant in court
assist in apprehension and surrender of defendant
methods_authorized.quote: limited surety agent means any individual appointed by an insurer by power of attorney to execute or countersign bail bonds in connection with judicial proceedings

agent_type_tiers.quote: "bail bondsman" means a limited surety agent or a property bondsman as hereafter defined

runner_license_available.quote: "solicitor" means a person employed by a bail bondsman for the purpose of assisting the bail bondsman in presenting the defendant in court when required, or to assist in the apprehension and surrender of the defendant to the court or in keeping the defendant under necessary surveillance, and to solicit bail bond business

first_year_supervision_required.quote: the applicant shall complete thirty hours of on-the-job training under the direct supervision of a licensed bail bondsman who shall certify in writing that the applicant has been taught the subjects pertinent to the duties and responsibilities of a bail bondsman

power_of_attorney_required.quote: limited surety agent means any individual appointed by an insurer by power of attorney to execute or countersign bail bonds in connection with judicial proceedings

premium_rate_filed_and_approved.quote: No premium rate that has not been promulgated or otherwise approved by the superintendent shall be charged for any bail bond.

collateral_receipt_required.quote: the person from whom the collateral or security is taken is given a receipt describing the condition of the collateral or security at the time it is taken into the custody of the bondsman

collateral_held_in_fiduciary_capacity.quote: All funds of others received by a person licensed or acting as an insurance producer, surplus line broker, bail bondsman or their solicitor ... are received and held by the person in a fiduciary capacity.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: suggest or advise the employment of or name for employment any particular attorney to represent the bail bondsman's or solicitor's principal

security_deposit_required_for_company.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license to act as property bondsman, the applicant therefor shall deposit with the superintendent a surety bond in favor of the superintendent, or in lieu thereof a certificate of deposit, securities or a letter of credit

security_deposit_minimum_amount.quote: in a total aggregate amount of not less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000)

premium_trust_account_required.quote: When a bail bondsman accepts cash as collateral, the bondsman shall deposit the cash in the bondsman's trust account and give a written receipt for same

residency_requirement.quote: A person who otherwise meets the requirements for a professional or occupational license shall not be denied licensure or license renewal because the person does not live in New Mexico.

citizenship_or_work_authorization_requir.quote: It is the policy of this state that a person is eligible for occupational or professional licensure or certification for which that person is qualified, regardless of the person's citizenship or immigration status.

high_school_diploma_required.quote: be a high school graduate or have passed a high school equivalency examination

continuing_education_period_years.quote: Prior to renewal of a bail bondsman's or solicitor's license, a licensee shall complete annually continuing education requirements as prescribed by rule.
